body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Corel demonstrated its new digital art studio 'Paint it! Touch' during Digital Experience event at CES 2010.

Built specifically for use on Windows 7 and optimized for use on touch-screen computers, the Corel Paint it! Touch provides budding artists of any age with a unique artistic experience. Using the program, consumers can create original artwork with the touch of their fingertips. The programs touch-enabled capabilities let consumers add artistic touches to photos or create art from scratch using a number of realistic brushes and effects.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
